newsitem.title: FRANCE: CPR 1996 net income 361 mln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: CPR 1996 net income 361 mln Ffr.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
Return on equity (percent) 12.4 pct vs N/A

NOTE - Compagnie Parisienne de Reescompte gave its results in a statement. The ratio of operating costs to net banking income dropped to 66 percent from 70. Net income rose 28 percent, or 35 percent before a 20 million france provision for general banking risk. Unspecified provision was made for additional costs related to moving to a single currency. Tier one and two capital totalled 4,443 million francs. The bank raised its gross dividend to 33 francs including the tax credit and increase total distribution by 17 percent, or 65 percent of gross income. The three business areas, proprietary trading, CPR asset management and CPR Finance contributed to income growth.
